Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: 3:2 horizontal website hero photograph for Hungarian natural oak timber supplier
Primary request: A beautiful realistic architectural photograph of a natural European oak staircase in a contemporary warm white home.
Scene: quiet white plaster walls, pale limestone floor, soft daylight entering from a large side window.
Subject: one straight staircase with a lower landing, solid European oak closed treads and risers, delicate slim matte black vertical balustrade and handrail.
Composition: landscape 3:2, eye-level architectural camera, staircase clearly visible as a whole occupying the frame in a refined editorial composition, no ultra-wide distortion.
Lighting: warm natural daylight, soft defined shadows, tranquil and inviting.
Materials: honest pale golden European oak with realistic grain and subtle variations, matte oil finish, credible tread thickness.
Constraints: physically buildable continuous staircase geometry; consistent equal riser heights and tread depths; all balusters align with stair; no impossible floating sections, no people, no text, no logos, no watermark. This is an inspirational design photograph, not a claim of a real company reference project.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: 4:5 vertical detail photograph for oak timber website and social media
Primary request: Close-up architectural material photograph of a European oak stair tread edge and beautiful wood grain, with the broader staircase softly visible behind.
Scene: elegant warm white contemporary interior, soft natural daylight.
Subject: solid natural pale golden oak step nosing, clean joinery, authentic fine wood grain, tactile matte oil finish.
Composition: portrait 4:5. Photograph close enough to see the edge craftsmanship and oak texture, with several equal steps receding in the background; beautiful diagonal lines with plausible continuous staircase geometry.
Lighting: soft side daylight showing the grain and thickness.
Color: natural pale golden oak, cream whites, subtle black rail glimpse.
Constraints: realistic oak texture, no orange oversaturated stain, no plastic CGI surface, no people, no text, no logo, no watermark. This is an inspirational material image, not a real company reference.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: 4:5 vertical architectural inspiration photograph
Primary request: A tasteful U-turn oak staircase in a warm white interior with a distinctive refined composition.
Scene: contemporary European home, sculptural white plaster walls, sunlight gently falling across warm natural oak treads.
Subject: one physically plausible U-shaped staircase with two straight flights and a rectangular intermediate landing, solid pale golden European oak treads, warm white risers, thin elegant black steel balustrade.
Composition: vertical 4:5 architectural photograph viewed diagonally from the lower floor; clearly visible first flight, landing and returning upper flight, graceful repeated lines; architectural magazine quality.
Lighting: gentle warm daylight, calm residential atmosphere.
Materials: genuine-looking oak grain and matte finish.
Constraints: consistent buildable stair geometry and equal steps, continuous connected handrail with plausible posts, no duplicated or branching stairways, no people, no text, no logo, no watermark. Inspirational design image, not company portfolio evidence.

Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: finished Hungarian Facebook story advertisement, vertical 9:16, 1080x1920 composition
Primary request: Create a polished, tasteful social story advert for a Hungarian European oak timber supplier, inspired by premium architecture publishing.
Scene: beautiful photorealistic natural pale golden oak staircase in a warm white contemporary home, slim black railing, realistic continuous steps. The staircase photo occupies the middle majority of the story.
Design: deep forest green #173D31, cream #F6F3EA, natural oak. Cream upper panel with large elegant bold readable dark green Hungarian headline. Green lower panel with concise copy and a cream CTA. Clear editorial typography, generous spacing. Keep all text at least 120 px from top and bottom and 70 px from left and right for social safe areas.
Text (verbatim, preserve Hungarian accents):
"TÖLGYFA LÉPCSŐT TERVEZEL?"
"Az alapanyagot mi adjuk."
"Beszerelést nem vállalunk."
"Kérj ajánlatot!"
"tolgyalapanyag.hu/lepcso"
Text hierarchy: headline largest; second sentence prominent; installation limitation clearly readable in regular smaller text; cream call-to-action button on green with 'Kérj ajánlatot!'; URL centered below button. The headline may break across three lines. Exactly these five text items and no other text.
Constraints: no invented logos, no added company portfolio claim, no people, no watermarks, no misspellings, no inaccurate accents, no cropped text. Refined warm architectural advertising, professional text alignment, flat full-bleed creative without device mockup.
